title: Ruby on Rails Developer
description: A deep, project-based roadmap for Ruby on Rails Developer: Create Rails applications with Ruby, MVC, Active Record, REST, authentication, testing, background jobs, and deployment.

tree.name: Foundations and Role Context
tree.description: Understand what Ruby on Rails Developer work looks like, which problems it solves, and the baseline concepts needed before building.

children.description: Learn the vocabulary, workflows, constraints, and decision-making patterns used by practitioners in this role.

children.name: Tooling and Daily Workflow
children.description: Set up the core tools, local environment, version control habits, debugging workflow, and documentation style.

tree.name: Core Skills and Implementation
tree.description: Build the practical skill stack for Ruby on Rails Developer through small exercises, realistic constraints, and repeatable workflows.

children.description: Work with issues, pull requests, release notes, stakeholder demos, decision records, and measurable acceptance criteria.

tree.name: Portfolio and Career Readiness
tree.description: Turn your Ruby on Rails Developer learning into proof: case studies, GitHub artifacts, demos, interview stories, and clear role positioning.

children.name: Case Study Writing
children.description: Write a concise case study with problem, constraints, decisions, implementation, validation, outcomes, and next improvements.

children.name: Project: Ruby on Rails Developer Portfolio Capstone
children.description: Build a portfolio-grade Ruby on Rails Developer project with a README, diagrams or screenshots, tests/checks, deployment or demo notes, and a lessons-learned section.
